title: Join this group
lede: Somebody sent you a code that lets you join their group. Enter the name they will know you by - that is all this asks for.

form.title: Who is joining
form.description: The group will use this name wherever it names you: on a commitment, in a settlement plan, and beside your share of it. Nothing here checks it, and nothing about the code says who you are.
form.identity: This build has no sign-in yet, so this page makes an identity for you and shows it once you have joined. Keep it: it is what other screens will show beside your name until signing in exists.
form.name: Your name, as the group will know you

joined.title: You are in
joined.description: The group has you as a member now. This is the whole of what accepting the code did.
joined.name: {name} is a member of this group.
joined.idNote: That identifier is you in this group. There is no sign-in to recover it from, so keep it somewhere you will find it.
